name: Johnny Walker
summary: A huge, awkward, explosive Brazilian moving up to heavyweight after a confused few years at light heavyweight: the wild aggression that made him was coached out, leaving a fighter who freezes at range and gets knocked out when opponents force the issue.

how_they_fight.Striking: Long (208-cm reach) and dangerous when he lets go; recent fights have been tentative (the Dominick Reyes split decision saw neither man lead).
how_they_fight.Grappling: Was outwrestled by Nikita Krylov years ago; wrestling defense about 56%.
how_they_fight.Defense & durability: Stopped by Volkan Oezdemir and Magomed Ankalaev (2024): chin is a concern, now against heavier punchers.
how_they_fight.Pace & cardio: Should be better without the cut to 205.
how_they_fight.Fight IQ: Indecisive lately; the hope is heavyweight frees him up.

patterns: Waits at range; flashes of explosive offense
keys_to_beat: Apply consistent pressure and make him fight going backward
